tiebreakers.description: Fewest reputation stars lost to monsters across all seasons; remaining ties share victory.

notes: family: flip-write. Transcribe the eight edict scores from the map sheet; evaluate assigned scoring cards separately each season. Coin totals and monster penalties recur each season. Multiplayer base only; no fixed player ceiling in rules (100 is included map-sheet supply, not a hard limit). Solo subtracts the four scoring-card difficulty values and awards a title; not modelled.
